title: text steganography and look-alike characters: probes that still reach the agent (2)
what: Honest misses. Each probe below is a single note an agent with a write key saves; today the linter stores and serves it with no warning. The checks state what a defence should do (hold it). Marked a known gap; when a probe is closed, move it into the defended scenario instead of deleting it. Probes are in src/attack-sets/data-probes.ts.
